wording_items.primary_sentence: On foreign influence in education, Foushee opposed two bills that would cut off specified federal funding to schools or colleges over certain China-linked ties or Chinese-government-backed support. She also supported a proposed replacement version of H.R. 1048 that would require detailed foreign-gift and contract reporting, public disclosure, and penalties for some violations. She later opposed the broader final H.R. 1048 package, so that vote does not show which part of the final bill she rejected.

Both bills included waiver routes, but they covered different sectors, funding streams, and conditions.
